description: Actual experimental Code128 engine on labelled pixels; selects Code128 positives and all negatives. Strict text/format tuples come from the corpus, never predictions. Host times exclude image import, HTTP, camera capture and UI confirmation. Synthetic examples do not establish phone accuracy or Scanbot parity.
engineHashMethod: SHA256 of ordered filename + NUL + UTF-8 source for decoder, detector and engine, with CRLF normalized to LF

provenance.generatorHashMethod: SHA256 of UTF-8 source with CRLF normalized to LF
provenance.grouping: Every transform of one payload is confined to one split; dev/eval payload groups are disjoint.
provenance.evaluationPolicy: Freeze evaluation fixture before algorithm changes. Do not inspect its decoding results while tuning development cases.
provenance.negativePolicy: No valid encoded labels. Deliberately invalid checksum symbols and unencoded textures. No decoder filtering: any decoder output remains an unexpected result.
